contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, probable British imitation or Barbarous Radiate. Possibly Tetricus Junior with an oval shaped flan and obverse struck off centre, too far right. Obverse: Radiate bust right (appears young and clean shaven). Inscription: Illegible. Reverse: Central standing figure, left. Probably PRINC(EPS) IUVENT(UTIS) - The Prince as leader of youth. Inscription: [PRIN](CIV)[VENT]. Mint name: By provenance. Die axis: 6 o'clock. Reece Period 13. The coin is in fair or very worn condition, the obverse with extreme wear in places. It has slightly irrregular flan edges, matt brown with a pale green matt corrosion over half the surface. This is likely to date…
